title: Understanding the Regex
text: The regular expression \d+ is used to match one or more digits in a sequence. In the sentence, look for any numbers.

title: Identify the Matches
text: Identify the numbers in the sentence "It has been $$71$$ years since the year 1954." that match the regex \d+.

title: Order of Matches
text: Remember to list the matches in the order they appear in the sentence. If there are no more matches, fill the remaining boxes with NA.
